title: AI Engineering Framework v2.1 Master
subtitle: Universal Agentic Architecture: Modular Adapters (Claw Code Rust, Ollama), Plugins (ECC, Karpathy, Ruflo), WSCI & Jidoka
summary: Universal agentic engineering constitution decoupled with a Modular Adapter layer (Claw Code CLI in Rust, Model Ollama, Git Worktrees), plugin ecosystem (Everything Claude Code, Karpathy Guidelines, Ruflo, Superpowers), Spec-as-Code governance, and automated bootstrap.
overview: The AI Engineering Framework v2.1 Master is a Universal Agentic Engineering Constitution designed to transform stochastic AI models into deterministic, disciplined operational team members. Version 2.1 introduces a formal decoupled Adapter Architecture across 5 essential categories (CLI, Model, Isolation, Verification, and Orchestration), strictly separating core principles and governance from execution technologies. The ecosystem natively integrates Claw Code (a high-performance clean-room rewrite with ~73% native Rust and async Python orchestration, 19 native tools, and MCP across 6 transports), zero-cost local models via Ollama, a rich ecosystem of first-class plugins and guides (Everything Claude Code / ECC, Andrej Karpathy Software 2.0 Guidelines, Ruflo Swarm Topology, Superpowers, and Open Design MCP), automated bootstrap workflows (bootstrap.sh), physical Git Worktree isolation, and WSCI context governance (Write, Select, Compress, Isolate) backed by industrial Jidoka (Andon Cord) quality containment.
roleDescription: AI Solutions Architect, Tech Lead & Agentic Process Engineer.
responsibilities: Conceived and designed the agentic governance architecture and modular Adapter Layer (CLI, Model, Isolation, Verification, and Orchestration), ensuring complete tool independence (Tool-Agnostic).
Integrated Claw Code as a high-performance CLI adapter, pairing a native 6-crate Rust runtime with async Python orchestration, 19 operational tools, and MCP across 6 transports.

Engineered the first-class plugin ecosystem and guides: Everything Claude Code (ECC), Andrej Karpathy Guidelines (Think Before Coding / Evidence Before Assumption), Ruflo Swarm Topology, and Open Design (MCP).
Architected the WSCI context engineering methodology (Write, Select, Compress, Isolate) and SPARC+DD lifecycle, eliminating model context window degradation and poisoning.
Developed the deterministic provisioning pipeline (bootstrap.sh) and standardized templates with a bilingual mirror architecture (canonical English and localized pt-BR).
Implemented Zero-Trust boundaries, Prompt Injection shields, and Jidoka (Andon Cord) quality gates for automated clean resets upon anomaly detection.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Tight coupling of governance rules to proprietary AI runtimes and tools (vendor lock-in, frequent breaking changes in commercial CLIs, and lack of standardization).
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Designed the Modular Technology Adapter Layer (adapters/): the Framework dictates universal principles, governance, and the META_SPEC; Adapters implement concrete technical bindings for CLIs (Claw Code Rust, Agy, Generic), Models (Ollama, Gemini, Anthropic), Isolation (Git Worktree), and Verification (Local runners), allowing any piece to be upgraded without modifying project rules.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Cognitive context window degradation (Poisoning, Distraction, Confusion) and speculative unauthorized refactorings during complex agent tasks.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented WSCI Context Engineering combined with Andrej Karpathy Guidelines (Think Before Coding, Evidence Before Assumption, Surgical Changes), physical Git Worktree isolation (Superpowers), and an industrial immediate-stop Jidoka (Andon Cord) mechanism.

futureEvolution: Expansion of Verification Adapters to support isolated ephemeral containers and remote CI/CD runners.
Automated telemetry tracking latency, accuracy, and token consumption across adapter categories (CLI Rust vs Python vs Node) under Zero-Trust policies.
Automated Architecture Decision Record (ADR) generation from synchronous multi-agent debates during the SPARC+DD Architecture phase.

owaspMitigations.title: Insecure Design (Zero-Trust AI Agents)
owaspMitigations.description: Agent execution under Zero-Trust architecture in isolated environments (Git Worktrees), strict privilege separation, and industrial Jidoka (Andon Cord) halt mechanisms.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection (Prompt Injection Boundary)
owaspMitigations.description: Strict treatment of all retrieved external content (RAG, Web, Issues) purely as untrusted data, shielding control instructions from malicious prompt injection.
